SEBI Warns Against Unregistered Social Media Trading Tips

The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has issued a warning to investors regarding live trading strategies and tips being shared on social media platforms. SEBI highlighted that many individuals offering such advice are unregistered and their actions risk causing financial losses to investors. The regulator's action aims to protect the public from potentially fraudulent or unqualified financial guidance.
